horoscope: With today’s New Moon, dear Aries, the desire to be productive and useful motivates you to start fresh. The week ahead can be a time of increased work, chores, and attention to your daily affairs and mundane tasks–it’s not the most glamorous time of the year! However, it can be an excellent time to focus on getting things right, fixing errors, and sorting things out. You're ready to get on top of your duties, chores, and routines. Keep in mind that while there is an opportunity to start fresh, your goals should be gently challenging and reasonable enough that you don’t psyche yourself out before even starting. Pace yourself! You’ll need to battle divided attention and an urge to do it all–try not to run ahead of yourself. Soon enough, you may implement new wellness routines, or you could be doing a top-to-bottom reorganization of your workspace. You might get something done well before a deadline or work ahead on a project that has long-term potential. Thinking about your overarching goals can help you recognize priorities.

Tonight’s New Moon is good for reorienting yourself in a new direction on an emotional level, dear Taurus. You'll want to start fresh on creative or romantic matters, and expressing and enjoying yourself more fully can be a goal. It's a powerful time for a new and improved approach to leisure time, love, dating, pleasure, or pastimes. This lunation can open doors for you on romantic and creative fronts in the coming week. It can be a time to start new hobbies or find new avenues for entertainment and creative expression. This New Moon encourages you to explore your passions and creativity more wholeheartedly — and heartfully! Aim to pace yourself and allow the process to unfold. Today, take your time with new initiatives.

Today’s New Moon can inspire you to focus more heartfully on your home and family life, dear Gemini, especially ideas that you’ve been toying with recently. New beginnings in the week ahead can relate to home, family, comfort, safety, familiarity, and long-term business ventures. You may feel genuinely excited about starting fresh or approaching these areas of life in new ways. Redecorating your home or creating greater peace and comfort with your loved ones can be a strong focus. It can be the time for a domestic makeover! You may feel a sense of mission regarding your home life, living conditions, or arrangements. Knowing your priorities helps you identify what needs to go and what could use some development or extra love and attention. This New Moon can serve as a nudge to reconnect with yourself or check in with your feelings and comfort levels before pressing forward.

Tonight's New Moon can stir a strong desire to make yourself heard or to commit or recommit to studies, dear Cancer. The urge to add more variety to your life is with you now, and you’re bound to put more of your personality into your communications, ideas, and interests. This New Moon is about starting fresh mentally, with communication projects or studies, mobility, or a personal interest. While a fresh start might sprout from a minor letdown or disappointment, you can be excited about approaching these life departments in new ways in the week ahead. The things you’re learning and sharing can be refreshing to your spirit. You’ve recently awakened to a stronger desire to reach out, learn, connect, and share your ideas, and with this New Moon, you’ll feel more directed and in charge. Launching new projects and putting ideas into action will get the green light, but do consider that objectivity is not yet with you. Take a bit of time for a plan to form. It’s best not to push things, even as anxious as you are to start fresh. Learning new or improving current skills, making new acquaintances, or connecting with others more meaningfully can figure strongly. You’re making a difference with what you say or how you connect with others.

With tonight’s New Moon, dear Leo, the coming week is active for new beginnings related to business, money, or special projects — anything that helps you build up, manage, or take charge of your resources. This lunation can open doors for you with personal finances, talents, and belongings. You might consider it a reboot of sorts in areas of life that help you to feel stable, supported, and secure. The coming period is an excellent time to find the enthusiasm and determination to complete a project, particularly business-related, that you’ve put on a shelf. It’s a time that spurs new beginnings regarding your relationship with your money and things. Still, pacing yourself is crucial — allow a plan to unfold naturally. You’ll be coming up with innovative or different approaches to your finances, income, personal resources, valuables, and self-worth as you advance.

Tonight’s New Moon occurs in your sign, dear Virgo, and it's about starting fresh. It’s a time to set your intentions for the year ahead related to your personality, independence, personal image, and effectiveness. In truth, it’s one of the best times to consider making personal changes that empower you. You may experiment with new ways of presenting yourself and approaching the world. It’s a time of personal reinvention, but it’s best to take some time with new beginnings, allowing a plan to unfold naturally in the coming days. Today’s New Moon puts you in charge--you have the power to make essential changes. You might decide to present yourself in a brand new way during this exceptionally dynamic and creative time. Make plans to pay more attention to your own needs and happiness during this period when healthy self-focus is especially appropriate. The chances are good that you’ve been feeling ready for a reboot or restart, and this New Moon may very well be it.

With tonight’s New Moon, circumstances prompt much-needed downtime and introspection, dear Libra. In the coming days, you may feel especially motivated to improve or focus on your private life, mental health, and emotional well-being. This lunation has the power to push you along a new path of self-discovery, healing, and empowerment, which can come in very handy when the Sun enters your sign on September 22nd. Getting comfortable with your inner needs and desires should come first for best results, and understanding recent events are part of this. You can feel quite motivated to make changes that help you simplify and strengthen your life. Getting rid of unnecessary material things can be helpful, and so can weeding out problematic thinking or attitudes that are not doing you any favors. This New Moon gives a gentle push to put the past behind you with plans, actions, or even symbolic actions. You’re tying up loose ends or dealing with secrets, private matters, and karma. It’s time to clear the slate!

With tonight’s New Moon, you’ll soon be moving in a new direction, dear Scorpio. This lunation highlights friendships, group connections, networking, long-term dreams and hopes, ideals, communications, and learning. A new beginning or revised initiatives may emerge in the week ahead, and making contact or teaming up may be a strong focus. You're discovering things that genuinely make you happy and have you feeling included and involved. If you’ve been dissatisfied with particular associations or find yourself lacking in your social life, the coming week is about taking charge and making changes. It’s also a powerful time for new dreams and initiatives — you’re now planting the seeds of new projects or long-term goals. This New Moon can instead be about a new take on a friendship or project. You’re learning to pay more attention to your dreams and wishes, and it’s a good time for improving your connection to others or your community and, in the process, the quality of your life.

With tonight’s New Moon in your career and reputation sector, dear Sagittarius, you may recognize a need for a fresh start, a redo, or a new commitment to life path goals. It’s a time to redefine your objectives and, soon enough, commit to a plan or responsibility. Opportunities to improve your image or reputation may emerge. There can be a need to follow the rules or straighten out an area of your life. It’s a time of year when you’re more aware of your impact on others, but answering to yourself and your needs and capabilities is also vital. It’s also a time for pouring yourself into something you’re passionate about, or for recognizing that you’re best off with a plan, schedule, or strategy. Think about what you want to accomplish down the road, and avoid pushing too fast right now, as it may be premature. Pace yourself for the very best results. It’s certainly a good time to examine the elements of your personality you're projecting to society and take charge of your life direction.

Tonight’s New Moon occurs in your sector of spirit, higher learning, worldview, and belief systems or perspective, dear Capricorn. It acts as a charge, sending you in a new direction as you ride a feeling of renewal brought on by a new perspective on your life. The coming week brings increased bravery and spontaneity, and a chance to gain new knowledge or deepen your understanding of particular subjects. You’ll be building your faith, as well as understanding where you stand and what you believe. Sharing your experiences with others, publishing, marketing, or studies may be more in focus. It’s an excellent time for an attitude change for the better, positive feelings, optimism, and a stronger sense of purpose or meaning. Still, some self-reflection is appropriate so that you can get in better touch with your true desires. Increasingly, you are likely to feel stronger and more confident. For now, pace yourself, as an action plan may not be complete.

With today’s New Moon, intimate relationships can benefit from a new start or vision, dear Aquarius. This lunation can stir your motivation to develop a relationship or project further. A new direction, approach, or beginning is in store, mainly related to power dynamics, money, or support. A pursuit that requires dedication and concentration can be in focus in the week ahead. Alternatively, something happening around now can open your eyes to the need to handle debts or manage support and shared responsibilities more effectively. Right now, take your time and let inspiration come to you! Aim to pace yourself. This New Moon cycle sends you on an inward journey, but not necessarily a solitary one. You might enjoy some support or protective influences coming from unexpected places or from behind the scenes. Seeking advice or researching problem areas can be very helpful.

With today’s New Moon, dear Pisces, aim to set intentions and goals that better reflect your wants, needs, and expectations of others. This influence is in your partnership sector, and the energy is powerful for a fresh start or turning point. New beginnings related to close relationship goals and needs are in the works. It can also be a time to pair up for a common goal or to work on your ability to balance, harmonize, and compromise with others for mutual benefits. It's wise to distinguish between making changes for the sake of change and making changes that will genuinely propel you forward on an improved path. Your vision for your relationship needs will begin to bloom and fill out, and someone can inspire you to pursue a dream. The desire or need to cooperate and merge with others is strong and motivating.
